From: Megan Lee <megan.lee@evergreenhealth.ai>

Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + hosted API pricing request for POC

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for taking this — I'm Megan, head of Engineering at Evergreen Health. We're evaluating hosted LLM providers for a short POC (3 months) to power a clinical-document summarization + Q&A assistant. Before we schedule a deeper sync, can you send a compact rate rundown + model catalog for Redwood's hosted API? Specifically we need:

- Standard per-1M token rates broken out by input vs output (we bill separately) for the models you expose on hosted.
- A short list of hosted model SKUs you'd recommend for summarization and for higher-quality long-form generation.
- Any volume discount bands and the thresholds (we're likely to start ~8M tokens/month, could grow to 40M in year 1 if POC succeeds).
- Trial/credit options and any short-term commitment requirements.

For context, our expected prompt sizes are ~300–450 tokens, average generated response ~800–1,500 tokens depending on prompt. POC window: 3 months; estimated starting run-rate: ~8M tokens/month (input+output combined).

If you can include a one-page example cost calc (we prefer a per-1M input / per-1M output example with 8M usage) and any quick notes on SSO/SOC2 and data retention (we may need SOC2 evidence), that'd be great.

Thanks,
Megan
Megan Lee
Head of Engineering, Evergreen Health

Megan — thanks for the clear context and the estimate file. Quick reply with a compact baseline and next steps; I'll attach a one-sheet ratecard as well.

Baseline hosted API per-1M token pricing (USD) — input / output split shown separately:

- Capability Tier (high-quality, ~pro-gen models; 32k+ context): input $24 / 1M tokens, output $60 / 1M tokens
- Standard Tier (balanced quality/latency): input $10 / 1M tokens, output $28 / 1M tokens
- Compact Tier (lower-cost, faster): input $4 / 1M tokens, output $10 / 1M tokens

Volume discounts (applied to list price by band; billed monthly):
- 0–5M tokens / month: list price
- 5M–25M tokens / month: 12% off list
- 25M–100M tokens / month: 22% off list

Trial and short-term POC offers:
- One-time trial credit: 5,000,000 tokens usable over 60 days for new accounts (hosted API only).
- No minimum commitment for the POC. If you convert to a committed plan, we offer additional discounting and an SLA.

Model catalog (hosted SKUs we recommend for your workloads):
- redwood-pro-32k (best for long-document summarization / context-heavy Q&A)
- redwood-standard-16k (good quality / cost balance for most summarization)
- redwood-compact-8k (fast, low-cost for high-throughput indexing tasks)
- meta-opt-13b-hosted (open-model fallback, lower-cost option)

Example cost snapshot (your stated starting point: 8M tokens/month, assume 60/40 split input/output):
- Input tokens: 4.8M -> at Standard input ($10/1M) = 4.8 * $10 = $48.00
- Output tokens: 3.2M -> at Standard output ($28/1M) = 3.2 * $28 = $89.60
- Monthly total (Standard tier): ~$137.60 (before any volume discounts or tax)

Notes:
- Prices above are list rates for hosted API and do not include enterprise add-ons (extended retention, private deployments).
- We can provide SOC 2 Type II reports and a security pack on request (we'll redact customer-specific info where needed).

Attachments: redwood-hosted-ratecard-202708.pdf (compact one-pager with banded pricing and SKU descriptions).

If this aligns, I can: 1) schedule a 30-minute technical walkthrough this week (marissa on the thread can run a short demo), 2) provision trial credits against your account, and 3) share SOC2 materials via our secure portal for procurement review.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

+1 (650) 555-0123

Megan — quick answers inline and next steps below.

1) IO billing: yes — billing is by direction. Every token you send to the API (input) is billed at the input rate, and every token returned by the model (output) is billed at the output rate. That includes cases where your prompt contains model-generated text from prior calls — we bill the request/response tokens actually transmitted.

2) Trial credit scope: trial credits are account-level and can be used against any hosted SKU, including redwood-pro-32k. Credits are applied to list price before any volume discount; they expire 60 days after issuance.

3) SOC2 / MSA: we have a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and an MSA template we can share. I will send SOC2 via our secure portal (link below) and attach the MSA draft for procurement review. Typical onboarding to enable hosted trial credits is 48–72 hours once we have a signed non-production access form from procurement.

Next steps I propose:
- I'll provision the 5M trial credit to an account tied to megan.lee@evergreenhealth.ai once we receive the signed non-production access form (attached as a one-page form).
- Marissa will run a 30-min demo on Wed Aug 24 at 09:30 PT (I've tentatively booked it).
- I'll push the SOC2 redacted PDF to your secure procurement portal and share a DocuSign link for the non-prod access form and MSA redline starter.

Links & attachments:
- Secure SOC2 portal: https://secure.redwood.com/soc2/evgr-portal (procurement-only link)
- DocuSign: https://docusign.com/transaction/XYZ-789 (non-prod access form + MSA starter)
- Attachment: redwood-hosted-ratecard-202708.pdf

If this works, I'll loop in our contracts manager (karthik on cc) to fast-track the DocuSign.

Best,
Vivek
